text:
Taylor: Short follow-up thread for the KV-cache OOM postmortem. I want clear owners + tiny ETAs so we don't lose momentum.
Maya: I'll own profiling and artifact collection.
Samir: Taking eviction policy experiments and basic dashboarding.
Eli: I'll handle jemalloc/allocator tuning and a canary compaction change.
Taylor: Proposed micro-actions: 
  - Maya: run deterministic heap snapshots + sampling on replay, attach flamegraph and a 2-line diagnosis. ETA: Tue EOD.
  - Samir: run segmented/LRU/TTL eviction variants on staging, capture evictions/s, miss-latency, resident. ETA: Thu COB.
  - Eli: enable background purge every 60s on 10% canary, measure p50/p95/p99 and CPU delta; report no-regress policy. ETA: Mon AM.
  - infra-bot: create tickets and add logs/traces and ephemeral throttles for noisy runs.
infra-bot: Tickets: INF-4001 (alloc-profiling), INF-4002 (eviction-trials), INF-4003 (allocator-compaction). Links: https://jira.redwood/INF-4001, https://jira.redwood/INF-4002, https://jira.redwood/INF-4003
oncall: Reminder: set temporary alert windows when doing heavy staging work to avoid wakeups.
Maya: Commands I'll run: `python3 tools/trace_replay.py --trace traces/repro-2026-03 --duration 3600 --out=alloc.trace` then `heapdump --pid $PID --out heap.snap` and `flamegraph.pl alloc.fold > alloc.svg`. Will attach to INF-4001.
Samir: Eviction knobs: start `segment_size=65536 max_fill=0.8`, then `segment_size=32768 max_fill=0.6` if needed. Will track hit-rate and latency.
Eli: Stats commands: `jeprof --text /tmp/prof.heap > jemalloc.txt`, `cat /proc/$PID/smaps | grep -i rss`. Will canary a 10% config and watch p99.
Taylor: Can we add a 1-line daily status to each ticket? e.g., "progress: flamegraph collected" or "progress: eviction test run done". Aim to close mitigations or escalate by Apr 15.
Maya: Acked ✅. Posting flamegraph Tue EOD.
Samir: Will post staging graphs Wed.
Eli: Canary Mon, reporting perf impact.
Taylor: Scheduling 3 weekly 30m check-ins Thu 09:00 PST. I'll invite owners.
infra-bot: Calendar invite "KV frag remediation standup" Thu 09:00 PST, 3 occurrences, invitees: Taylor, Maya, Samir, Eli.
oncall: I'll add a temporary throttle to staging during the experiments to reduce blast radius.
Maya: Note: sampling profilers undercount tiny short-lived allocs; I'll include deterministic snapshots where possible.
Samir: If eviction reduces resident but increases miss latency, we'll iterate with hotset pinning + smaller segments.
Eli: If compaction costs too much CPU, we'll explore staggered compaction windows and adaptive thresholds.
Taylor: Thanks all. If anything blocks, post here and tag me. End goals: reproduce fragmentation reliably, validate mitigations vs latency, land conservative fixes by Apr 15.
Maya: uploading first artifacts now.
Samir: starting seg tests in stg in 40m.
Eli: prepping jemalloc canary.
